reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) directly states that solid solution strengthening by Zr is the main reason for superior specific yield strength at 1023 K and 1123 K, and that room-temperature plasticity remains appropriate (ε > 0.35). The baseline comparison to typical RHEAs without Zr is implied but not explicitly controlled in the cited study, which only varies Zr content within its own alloys; this is a minor gap.
premises: Zr addition induces solid solution strengthening in RHEAs
This strengthening improves high-temperature compressive-specific yield strength
The improvement holds at 1023 K and 1123 K
The baseline is RHEAs without Zr
